visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The hit is a fresh-seed retake because the first take's plate went black in long stretches and a steady-light retake flipped it toward cyan; it flinches behind the shield and recovers to the stance. The idle snaps between two stances within two frames, so it ping-pongs the steady stretch at 44-88. The walk loops one cycle over 59-117. The death skips the green-smeared frames at 57-58 before the topple. Attack, defend and cast are used as generated.
